entities.name: Valakut
entities.description: Volcanic mountain on Beyeen, largest peak of the Crown of Talib.

entities.name: Beyeen
entities.description: Island off the coast of Ondu.

entities.name: Crown of Talib
entities.description: Ring of volcanic mountains at the heart of Beyeen.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose emergence began Valakut's near-constant eruptions.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People who named the range after their earth god.

events.summary: Since the first emergence of the Eldrazi, Valakut has erupted almost constantly.
events.quote: Since the first emergence of the Eldrazi , Valakut has erupted almost constantly
